n = int(input())
ones = [0] * 17
for i in range(1, 17):
    ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1

def dfs(ones, n, idx):
    quot = n // ones[idx]
    n %= ones[idx]
    onesUsedHere = quot * idx
    if n == 0:
        return onesUsedHere
    else:
        return onesUsedHere + min(dfs(ones, n, idx - 1),
                                  idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - n, idx - 1))

ans = dfs(ones, n, 16)
print(ans)
